title: Three Summers and One Short Comb
subtitle: 生态保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生态保护（人与自然·环境保护·生态保护）
meta: 主题语境：生态保护（人与自然·环境保护·生态保护）　|　核心词汇：honey　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 honey 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the beekeeper ① tasted the honey that no buyer in the orchard would have described, and he said the tasting was the whole of the summer. The ② honey, meaning the sweetness itself and not the comb, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; honey, he said, is the only thing in a orchard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ piece of honey in that orchard had the same short comb beside it, and the ④ honey at the far tree, meaning the jar they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Honey, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the beekeeper said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the honey was the whole of the matter, meaning the reward and not the sweetness. The ⑥ honey, meaning the reward and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; honey, he said, is either something you taste or the only word that means both sweetness and a reward. He said the reward is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ honey had become a line in a label, and the label had become an argument about the short comb. The ⑧ honey of the whole thing, the beekeeper wrote in January, was one orchard and three summers of describing; honey, he said, is either the jar at the far tree or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ honey I remember is the honey described in the label, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the orchard. ⑩ Honey, my mother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being described; all honey, she said, is a reward that has agreed to look like sweetness. She said the reward was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 蜂蜜（指果园里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 蜂蜜（指那罐蜜本身，与巢脾相对）
C. 固定搭配：taste the honey 尝一尝蜂蜜
D. n. 蜂蜜（指留给孩子们尝的那一罐那一罐）
E. n. 蜜事（抽象总称，指一处果园的蜂蜜之事）
F. n. 蜂蜜（指标签里写到、被记下的的那一罐）
G. n. 回报、馈赠（指一件事里人人都采却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 馈赠（抽象总称，指人人都采却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tasted the honey that no buyer in the orchard would have described
The honey, meaning the sweetness itself and not the comb
Every piece of honey in that orchard
the honey at the far tree
the honey was the whole of the matter
the honey had become a line in a label
The honey of the whole thing

answers.why: taste the honey 意为“尝一尝蜂蜜”，1974 年那位养蜂人把果园里没有一位买主肯描述的一罐蜂蜜做了一遍。
honey 意为“蜂蜜”，指那罐蜜本身而不是巢脾，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
honey 意为“蜂蜜”，指果园里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一片窄窄的巢脾。
honey 意为“蜂蜜”，指最远那棵树下留给孩子们尝的那一罐那一罐，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
honey 意为“回报、馈赠”，指一件事里人人都采却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份回报就是那件事的全部。
honey 意为“馈赠”，指人人都采却无人提起的那样东西而不是那罐蜜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
honey 意为“蜂蜜”，指标签里写到、被记下的的那一罐，到 1979 年这一罐成了标签里的一行。
honey 意为“蜜事”，养蜂人一月写道，整件事的蜂蜜之事是一处果园和三个夏天的描述。
honey 意为“蜂蜜”，我记得的是标签里描述过的那一罐，1981 年卖完了，至今仍被说成果园里最安静的一罐。
honey 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，蜂蜜是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的蜜。
